entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this piece of junk VeloBand Pulse you sold me. And don't give me any runaround about it being too late.
I understand you're frustrated, and I can certainly look into the return options for you. To start, could I get your name and order number, please?

The name is Karen Miller. Order number is VF77819. Look, I've had it for over a month. I know what you're going to say. You're going to talk about your hygiene policy or some sanitation excuse. It's ridiculous and I'm not having it.

Thank you for that, Karen. I see the order here. It was delivered 36 days ago. I understand your concern about the policy. Just so I can properly document this, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It doesn't matter! It's uncomfortable, the battery life is a joke, and I want my money back. I'm not troubleshooting it. Are you going to process this return or do I need to speak to your manager right now? I will light up your social media with reviews.

I understand you'd just like to proceed with the return. No need for a manager, I can handle this for you. Our return policy can have specific timeframes, especially for wearable items. Please allow me to place you on a brief one-minute hold while I verify the exact policy for your VeloBand Pulse.
Fine. But if you come back and tell me it's too late, you're going to have a serious problem on your hands.
(On hold for 45 seconds) ... Karen? Thank you for your patience. I've pulled up our internal knowledge base to check the return policy for you.

Actually, I have good news. I've confirmed that all VeloFit items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're only on day 36, you are well within that window. I can process this return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh. Really? Ninety days? I was... sure it would be a huge fight. I was all ready.

No fight necessary. My apologies if our website made the policy seem unclear. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to the email on file now. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it at any post office. You should see the refund within 5-7 business days after we receive it.
Wow. Okay. Well, thank you. That was... much easier than I expected. I appreciate your help, David.
You're very welcome, Karen. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Have a wonderful rest of your day. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
